base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq git curl wget apt-transport-https
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export DOTNET_ROOT=/usr/share/dotnet && export PATH=$PATH:$DOTNET_ROOT && dotnet --version && echo ACTIVATION_OK'

runtime_profile.package_manager: NuGet (via dotnet CLI) - offline mode using BCL only
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: Test runner uses only .NET BCL (Base Class Library) - no external NuGet packages required. Uses dotnet run with a console app that mimics test output format for H6 recognition.
runtime_profile.notes: .NET SDK 8.0 is installed at system level. No virtual environment needed. Test execution uses dotnet run with a self-contained console app that requires only BCL types (System, System.Globalization). No external NuGet packages are needed, making it fully offline-capable.

notes: Base image mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 already includes .NET 8.0 SDK, git, and curl. The setup_runtime.sh script is idempotent and will skip installation if dotnet is already available. This is a cross-platform C# project targeting .NET 8.0. Test execution uses a BCL-only console app (no NUnit) for offline compatibility. The test app references the workspace osu.Game project to test EditorTimestampParser directly.
